source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.
2.
completion:
Identify dates and times when the emission exceeds the regulation limit. 
3. Match the time and dates to the average daily wind direction of the monitoring location. (Wind direction only needs to be accurate to the nearest compass point.)
4. Check for whether wind speed is greater than 11.2 mph. If wind speed is greater than this, the data and emission should be discounted. (The official minimum wind speed for Texas monitoring sites is 10.1 mph. For documentation purposes, I recommend getting an absolute positive in wind speed.)
5. Visually check the data to make sure the peak is a reasonable representation of the data peaks. (This is to make sure the stack vent is not spewing on two different times but the data representation appears to only show one emission event.)
